clue.text: Vegetarian male cut intake of food

parts.note: to cut your intake of food is to eat less, as on a diet

explanation.surface: A man on a diet trims his meals and gives up meat.
explanation.definitionFit: A vegetarian meal or diet is one made without any animal flesh.

clue.text: He goes to work with a will

definitions.text: He goes to work with a will

parts.words: He goes to work with a will
parts.note: reads as an energetic worker, but the will is a legal testament whose instructions this person carries out

explanation.definitionFit: The person named in a testament to carry out its terms after a death goes to work on that will.

clue.text: Stuff from tube osteopath ordered after start of treatment

indicators.note: the shuffled letters come after the single letter in the answer
the start of a word is its first letter, so only the opening letter of treatment is used
the letters of osteopath are ordered, put into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A bone specialist prescribes something from a tube as the first step of treatment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stuff from tube' sounds like a medical sample, but it is the paste you squeeze each morning; 'ordered' shuffles OSTEOPATH into OOTHPASTE.
explanation.definitionFit: Dental paste is the stuff squeezed out of a tube onto a toothbrush.

clue.text: Ponder awkwardly broken shin painkillers naturally needed

indicators.note: done awkwardly, the letters of Ponder fall into a clumsy new order
something broken is in pieces, so the four letters of shin are rearranged

explanation.surface: A broken shin needs pain relief, which is something to think about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awkwardly' turns PONDER into ENDORP and 'broken' turns SHIN into HINS; 'needed' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The body makes these hormones itself to dull pain, so they are natural painkillers.

clue.text: Late meal includes cold dish

indicators.note: the meal word includes, holds inside it, the letter for cold

parts.note: supper is a meal eaten late in the evening
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: An evening meal features a chilled dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dish' is the verb, as in dashing someone's hopes, not a plate of food.
explanation.definitionFit: To dish a plan is to ruin it, the same as sinking or wrecking it.

clue.text: Fish balls are sometimes served for starters

indicators.note: the starters of these words are their opening letters, like the first course of a meal

explanation.surface: Fishballs sometimes appear on the menu as a first course.
explanation.walkthrough: The stray 'IS' is a scanning artefact; 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A bass is a kind of sea or freshwater fish, such as the sea bass.

clue.text: Group of apprentices shown how siren might operate?

indicators.note: a group of consecutive letters taken from the word apprentices

explanation.surface: A class of trainees is shown how a warning siren works.
explanation.walkthrough: The siren is not an alarm but the mythical singer who lured sailors; 'shown' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sirens of myth tempted and lured sailors with their song, which is what this verb means.

clue.text: Girl's a catch in spring

indicators.note: the article and the catch go in the middle of the spring word

parts.note: a jete is a springing leap in ballet
a net is used to catch fish, and a haul is a catch

explanation.surface: A girl is a real catch in springtime.
explanation.walkthrough: A jete is a leap in ballet, hence 'spring'; the possessive 's in 'Girl's' is just 'is', a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A female first name, so it can stand for a girl in a clue.

clue.text: Link half-severed at end of tea dance

indicators.note: the shortened link word comes at the end, after the tea

parts.note: cha is a colloquial word for tea

indicators.note: severed in half, the link word keeps only its first half, five of its ten letters

parts.note: a connection is a link

explanation.surface: A chain snaps partway through at the close of a tea dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half-severed' keeps CONNE, the front half of CONNECTION, which goes at the end of CHA; the surface's tea dance is a red herring, since only 'dance' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: A chaconne is a stately old dance in triple time, also a musical form built on it.

clue.text: Back a bit

definitions.meaning: to back a proposal is to support it formally in a meeting
a bit, a moment, as in wait a tick

explanation.definitionFit: Supporting a motion is seconding it, and a brief moment of time is likewise a tick.

clue.text: Political party's work place

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a work in music
a position is a place

explanation.surface: A party's office is its workplace.
explanation.definitionFit: The party out of power in parliament is known collectively by this name.

clue.text: Makes a fuss of returning this short distance

indicators.note: returning means the word for making a fuss is read backwards

parts.note: to pet an animal is to make a fuss of it

explanation.surface: Someone fussing over a person who comes back a little way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'this' is a link, pointing at the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A single pace covers only a small distance, as in just a few paces away.

clue.text: PA making offer to check shortened version of story

indicators.note: to check is to hold back or restrain, so the offer word holds the shortened story inside it

parts.note: to present is to offer

indicators.note: the story word is shortened by losing its last letter

parts.note: a saga is a long story

explanation.surface: A personal assistant offers to vet a cut-down version of a story.
explanation.walkthrough: PA here stands for press agent, not personal assistant; SAG (SAGA shortened) goes inside PRESENT.
explanation.definitionFit: PA abbreviates press agent, a publicist who handles a client's dealings with newspapers.

clue.text: Animals even now completely motionless

parts.note: stock is farm animals, as in livestock
still means even now, as in it is still raining

explanation.surface: Farm animals are frozen in place even now.
explanation.definitionFit: Standing utterly without movement, as a post or tree trunk stands.

clue.text: Epistle's estimable writer

parts.note: Gal is the abbreviation for the Epistle to the Galatians in the Bible, with the 's giving S
estimable means worthy of respect

explanation.surface: A letter belonging to a respected author.
explanation.walkthrough: John Galsworthy wrote The Forsyte Saga.
explanation.definitionFit: John Galsworthy was a Nobel-winning English novelist and playwright.

clue.text: Go to market, we're told, for a piece of canvas

indicators.note: we're told signals that what follows is heard spoken, a sound-alike

parts.note: to take goods to market is to try a sale of them

explanation.surface: Someone advised to sell goods at market, as though selling a sail.
explanation.walkthrough: TRY SALE, spoken, sounds like the sail word.
explanation.definitionFit: A trysail is a small strong sail of canvas set in stormy weather.

clue.text: Brown loaf cut and wrapped for minute, elevenses

indicators.note: the brown word is wrapped round the cut loaf, holding it in its middle

parts.note: teak is a brown colour, from the wood

indicators.note: the loaf is cut, losing its last letter

parts.note: a loaf is bread

explanation.surface: A brown loaf sliced and wrapped for a short morning snack.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' takes the D off BREAD to give BREA; 'for minute' only paints the brief pause and gives no letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Elevenses is a mid-morning pause for a cuppa and a biscuit, a British custom.

clue.text: Aspiring forest worker, say

indicators.note: say signals that the words are heard, so a sound-alike is wanted

parts.note: a wood bee, a worker bee living in a forest

explanation.surface: A keen young forest labourer.
explanation.walkthrough: WOOD BEE spoken sounds like the hyphenated answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone hoping to become something is an aspiring version of it, as in an aspiring writer.

clue.text: Starting point of unholy row

parts.note: base means low, ignoble, so morally unholy
a row is a line

explanation.surface: An ungodly quarrel is where it all began.
explanation.definitionFit: A reference measurement from which change is judged is the place to start.

clue.text: Fine animal that's way the most cunning

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencils
an ox is an animal
ie, id est, means that is
St is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: A handsome creature proves the sliest of all.
explanation.definitionFit: Like a fox, the slyest person is the most crafty and cunning.

clue.text: Sweet wine, something earth-shattering

parts.note: afters is British slang for pudding, the sweet course
hock is German white wine from the Rhine

explanation.surface: A dessert wine that hits like a quake.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is literal: a tremor that follows an earthquake.
explanation.definitionFit: A tremor following a big earthquake literally shakes the earth again.

clue.text: Vicar's reeling, having got in wallop … here?

definitions.text: Vicar's reeling, having got in wallop … here?

indicators.note: the beating word has got the turned clergyman in its middle

parts.note: to tan a hide is to wallop it

indicators.note: reeling means the clergyman's title is turned round, read backwards

parts.note: Rev is short for Reverend, a vicar's title

explanation.surface: A vicar stumbling about after drinking beer at the pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reeling' turns REV backwards to VER. Wallop is also British slang for beer, so the whole clue paints a pub.
explanation.definitionFit: An inn or alehouse is where a churchman might drink enough ale to stagger.

clue.text: Clever, but appears to confuse compass points?

definitions.meaning: the four letters split as ..., saying west is east, a muddle of compass directions

explanation.definitionFit: Shrewd and knowing people are clever ones.

clue.text: Preacher supplies names of candidates for religious studies exam?

parts.note: RE, religious education, is a British school subject
a viva is an oral examination
a list gives the names of candidates

explanation.surface: A minister supplies the shortlist for a theology viva.
explanation.definitionFit: A preacher who stirs religious fervour at revival meetings is called this.

clue.text: A sailor's spoken of as a war hero

indicators.note: spoken of means the word is heard aloud, a sound-alike

parts.note: Jack, a jack tar, is a sailor, and the 's adds S

explanation.surface: A seaman is talked of as a battle hero.
explanation.walkthrough: JACKS heard aloud gives JAX after A.
explanation.definitionFit: Ajax was a Greek warrior in the Trojan War, second only to Achilles.

clue.text: Understand computers etc can be attached to versatile unit

indicators.note: the computing letters are attached to the end of the rearranged unit
versatile means adaptable, so the word unit is rearranged

parts.note: IT, information technology, covers computers and the like

explanation.surface: Grasp that computers can be plugged into an adaptable unit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'versatile' makes INTU from UNIT; IT is attached to it.
explanation.definitionFit: To grasp something by instinct, without reasoning, is to sense or understand it.

clue.text: Getting into top-rated books is hard … for these?

definitions.text: Getting into top-rated books is hard … for these?

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, written AI

indicators.note: the hard letter is getting into the joined pair of words

parts.note: reads, as in a good read, are books
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: Reading good books is a struggle for empty-headed people.
explanation.walkthrough: A1 (written AI) means first-rate, and 'reads' as a noun means books; the whole clue defines the empty-headed folk.
explanation.definitionFit: Empty-headed people would find serious reading hard work.

clue.text: Hawkers with unbelievable desire to pocket millions

parts.note: a tall story is unbelievable

indicators.note: the desire word pockets the millions letter, holding it inside

parts.note: yen is a desire or longing
M is the abbreviation for million

explanation.surface: Street sellers are wildly keen to rake in millions.
explanation.definitionFit: Tallymen were door-to-door sellers who sold on credit and collected weekly, a British trade.
